sources.author: RU Apps
patch_list: Reduces MAX's external IP-checker fallback list to a single, blockable endpoint.
Disables runtime analytics tracking calls and initializers (AppMetrica, MyTracker, Firebase).
Disables analytics and tracking components and metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.

Disables AppsFlyer attribution/tracking: no-ops its SDK implementation's start() choke point (the actual activation entry point, called directly from app code — not manifest-gated in the v6+ SDK) and disables its install-referrer manifest…
Stops MAX's SampleUploadWorker (diagnostic uploads to apptracer.ru) and DailyAnalyticsWorker (daily permission-status telemetry) from doing any work.
Removes the advertising ID permission so ad and analytics SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.
